correctness.rationale: For every composite or prime base, B^b-B^a=B^a(B^(b-a)-1) has B-adic order a. Hence one marked square can contain only a unique pair at distance p, forcing two consecutive powers. Endpoint inequalities give all starts; the first missing third predicted marker proves the exact continuation length. Least-period and distinct-word arguments are explicit. The extracted standalone verifier independently tested all marked candidate windows at seven bases, periods <=150, and starts within length 2400.
